QuestInfo.name: Dazed and Confused
QuestInfo.1: As the Secret Garden's leader and the daughter of the previous Dark Lord, #bLady Syl#k deserves to know the truth. And guess who gets to tell her...
QuestInfo.2: Lady Syl seemed dazed by your explanation. Continue your training until she calls for you.

0.0: I finally understand Jin's part in all of this. It hasn't been easy for him, either. But... Lady Syl...
0.1: Lady Syl must know the truth. It is her right. Oh, she'll take it with her usual grace and aplomb, but I fear her nightmares will grow worse, once she learns she's been lied to all this time. Nonetheless, she MUST be told.
0.2: Will you deliver this document to Lady Syl? It's a report of everything we've learned. It will be easier for her to read it than to hear it from me.\r\n#r(You will be moved to Lady Syl's Room when you accept.)

1.0: Why so grim, #h0#? Bad day in the field? Don't be so harsh on yourself. You've done much for the Dual Blades already.\r\nWhat's this? A report from Ryden? This can't be good.

yes.0: (As Lady Syl reads the report, her face grows more and more pale. When she's done, she folds it and puts it away.) \r\nI see. Thank you for bringing me the report, #h0#. You have... You have done well.
yes.1: Now, if you'll excuse me. I need a moment to...collect my thoughts. I can't believe Jin... Excuse me.

lost.0: Will you deliver this document to Lady Syl? It's a report of everything we've learned. It will be easier for her to read it than to hear it from me.
